evidence.quote: In my view, the case for an increase in the federal funds rate has clearly strengthened since our previous meeting earlier this month.
But moving too slowly could eventually mean that the Committee would have to tighten policy abruptly to avoid overshooting our goals.
Taken together, labor market indicators show an economy that is on solid footing and close to our mandate of maximum employment.
So, while the current shortfall may seem small, it is important that inflation continue to move up to 2 percent, as I expect it will.
The main risks I see to that outlook are from abroad. Growth and inflation are low around the world.
